peopleAlsoAsk.question: Why would you use serum-free media?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet:
Advantages of using serum-free media include:

 Increased definition. More consistent performance. Increased growth and/or productivity. Precise evaluations of cellular function.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Can you use newborn calf serum instead of FBS for cell culture?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet:
NBCS – as an alternative

 Due to these disadvantages of FBS, less sensitive cell types are often cultivated with NBCS (Newborn Calf Serum) instead of FBS. The NBSC is usually derived from the calves that result as a “waste product” of the New Zealand and Australian dairy industry.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Why do we add FBS to DMEM?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Besides BSA, fetal bovine serum is a rich source of growth and attachment factors, lipids, hormones, nutrients and electrolytes necessary to support cell growth in culture. It is typically added to basal cell culture medium, such as DMEM or RPMI, at a 5–10% concentration.
